proposition: On Qāżīzāda Rūmī, Grammatology (2016) calls him the first director of Ulugh Beg's observatory, while Timurid-Mughal and the dissertation call him the second director. The dissertation says he and Ibn Turka studied together under Ṣadr al-Dīn in Samarkand for years and that Qāżīzāda followed him to Cairo; New Brethren and Timurid-Mughal say the friendship dated from childhood without locating it.
